description: This Perl script scans C source files within a specified directory to detect the usage of memory-related functions (free, alloc, strdup) and ensures that the files include the necessary header files 'memdebug.h' and 'curl_memory.h'. It reports files that do not include these headers when memory functions are used, and summarizes the number of errors found.

methods.name: scanfile
methods.description: Scans a given C source file to check for usage of memory functions and inclusion of required headers, returning 1 if headers are missing when needed, otherwise 0.
